name: Muscadet Sèvre et Maine

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Muscadet left on its dead yeast cells, the lees, after fermentation. It gains flavor and texture from them.
keyfacts: Muscadet is made in the Pays Nantais at the western end of the Loire Valley, from the Melon grape alone.
Muscadet Sèvre et Maine is the largest Muscadet appellation, with about 81% of the claimed vineyard area, and it takes its name from the rivers Sèvre and Maine.
The generic Muscadet AOC cannot use sur lie, but the three sub-appellations can.

blurb.text: A Muscadet appellation for white wine made only from Melon, from thirty communes around Vallet, Clisson and Vertou.
